groupKey.description: A function that maps a message to a group key. Messages that resolve to the same key are visually grouped (shared avatar, author name, etc.). Use createTimeWindowGroupKey(windowMs) to replicate time-window-based grouping.

index.description: The index of the row in items.

items.description: The ids of the messages in the list, in order.

messageId.description: The id of the message this row belongs to.

slotProps.description: The props used for each component slot.

sx.description: The system prop that allows defining system overrides as well as additional CSS styles.

slotDescriptions.messageActions: Actions row component (receives { messageId }). Pass null to hide actions entirely; omit to render only the declarative extraActions from slotProps.messageActions if provided.
slotDescriptions.messageAuthorName: Author name label rendered by the group wrapper (default variant: above the bubble; compact variant: inside the message grid). Pass null to hide.
slotDescriptions.messageAvatar: Avatar component. Pass null to hide the avatar entirely and drop the reserved avatar grid track.
slotDescriptions.messageError: Error card shown under the bubble when the message status is error. Pass null to hide the error surface entirely (no component is mounted).
slotDescriptions.messageGroup: The per-author group wrapper around consecutive messages.
slotDescriptions.messageInlineMeta: Inline meta rendered inside the bubble (default variant). Pass null to hide.
slotDescriptions.messageMeta: External meta (compact variant). Pass null to hide.
slotDescriptions.messageRoot: Styled root of <ChatMessage> (wrapper-only); the default avatar/content/meta tree still renders inside it.
slotDescriptions.streamingIndicator: The animated dots shown while an assistant response is in flight: as a trailing row while waiting for the response to start, then inside the assistant bubble while it streams. Controlled by features.streamingIndicator ('auto' by default). Pass null to hide it.
